hints.title: Euclidean Planar Coordinate Pair Distance
hints.text: Compute planar distance between distinct coordinate points and return the minimum rounded to two decimal places.

hints.title: Non-Identical Point Self-Join
hints.text: Join table with itself on points having distinct coordinates to prevent zero distance self-comparison, then apply the Euclidean metric.

hints.title: Shortest Distance Blueprint
hints.text: select round(min(sqrt(power(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + power(p1.y - p2.y, 2))), 2) as shortest from Point2D p1 join Point2D p2 on (p1.x <> p2.x or p1.y <> p2.y).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT ROUND(MIN(SQRT(POW(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + POW(p1.y - p2.y, 2))), 2) AS shortest
FROM Point2D p1
JOIN Point2D p2 ON (p1.x <> p2.x OR p1.y <> p2.y);
```

variables: N: number of coordinate points in Point2D
complexity.notes: Evaluating pairwise Euclidean combinations across distinct point tuples takes quadratic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining without distinct coordinate inequality evaluates zero-distance self pairs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scalar min aggregation collapses quadratic combinations into a single float metric.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of SQRT and POW mathematical functions with proper inequality join filter.
